body.p: At one time the Caribou and the Bear had a trial of strength. They locked their fore-arms and tried to pull. The Bear said to the Caribou, "I do not think you can stand the strain without your leg breaking." But the Caribou replied, saying that he was not afraid, since his legs were strong. Then they pulled, and the Caribou proved to be the stronger.[[See No. 37, p. 220.]]
